quasirobotics.notification.droid_package: Robots deploy from Manage Operators and the departure screen.
quasirobotics.desc.printyard: Builds and maintains combat droids. Unlocks the Robots roster and lets robots join missions
quasirobotics.desc.salvage_drones: Robots destroyed on a mission are recovered and returned to the ship for repair
quasirobotics.desc.drop_pods: Mission active, from Mission Control: robots left aboard drop onto the map in explosive pods and join the fight
quasirobotics.desc.robo_rapid_response_u: Robots are repaired twice as fast aboard the ship
quasirobotics.desc.robo_foam_canisters: Robots put out any fire on themselves at the end of their turn
quasirobotics.desc.robo_electric_fence: Robots shock any enemy that hits them with a melee attack
quasirobotics.droppods.unreachable: Drop Pods can't reach this location.
quasirobotics.droppods.recharging: Drop Pods are recharging. Next pod ready in {0}.
quasirobotics.droppods.no_robots: No robots are waiting aboard the ship.
quasirobotics.droppods.no_landing_zone: No safe landing zone for Drop Pods.
quasirobotics.mcm.drop_pods_key.tooltip: The key that calls Drop Pods while Mission Control is open. Click a slot, then press a key. Also in Options > Keybindings.
quasirobotics.mcm.start_printyard.toolti: Printyard comes installed in the Robotics room: in new campaigns, and in loaded campaigns that do not have it yet.
quasirobotics.mcm.start_salvage_drones.t: Salvage Drones come installed in the Robotics room: in new campaigns, and in loaded campaigns that do not have them yet.
quasirobotics.mcm.start_drop_pods.toolti: Drop Pods come installed in the Robotics room: in new campaigns, and in loaded campaigns that do not have them yet.
quasirobotics.mcm.robot_slots.tooltip: Robot slots from Printyard and from each Expanded Bays upgrade. At 2: 2 slots, up to 12 with every upgrade; at 3: up to 18.
Allies (robots, turrets and other units on your side) can no longer hurt you or each other. Your own shots still hit everyone.
quasirobotics.mcm.allies_first.tooltip: Turn order becomes Player, then allies (robots, turrets, followers), then enemies. Off: the game's order of Player, enemies, then allies.
quasirobotics.mcm.allow_vest_backpack: Robots can wear vests and backpacks
quasirobotics.mcm.allow_vest_backpack.to: Off: robots cannot be given a vest or backpack. Gear they already wear stays until you take it off.
quasirobotics.mcm.uninstall_mode.tooltip: Saving on the ship removes all QuasiRobotics data so the save loads without the mod. Robots return to cargo as stock packages; Robotics devices are removed and refunded.
quasirobotics.roster.no_packages: No robot packages in Ship's Cargo
quasirobotics.roster.add_failed: Could not add robot. See QuasiRobotics log.
quasirobotics.roster.dismantle_failed: Could not dismantle robot. See QuasiRobotics log.
